understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid, modify the carried piece so its shape, color, and rotation match each goal, then step onto every goal cell to complete all levels.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement uses cardinal actions and walls can block movement. Shape modifiers cycle shape, color modifiers cycle color, and rotation modifiers rotate the piece 90 degrees clockwise. Goals require simultaneous matching of all three attributes. Movement consumes stamina; reaching zero costs a life, and losing all lives ends the game. The rotation changer needed here was at [19,30], while the goal was at [34,10], requiring rotation 0° from the current 270°.
